3 MONTHLY PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE CHECKLIST
45 ITEMS
DOWNLOAD SCHEDULE
# CHECKPOINT OK ✓ NOT OK ✗ Remarks
AIR FILTER SERVICE (MANDATORY – Every 3 Months per Daikin Manual IOD-1014A)
1 Remove air filter from access panel – note filter size per unit tag
2 Filter sizes: PU-01: 750×950×25mm | PU-02: 400×700×25mm | PU-03: 400×900×25mm | PU-04: 550×800×25mm | PU-05/06/07/08: 350×750×25mm | PU-09: 550×800×25mm
3 Record filter condition before replacement: [ ] Slightly Dirty [ ] Dirty [ ] Very Dirty
4 Install new disposable filter (AAF International, 25mm thickness) – correct size and orientation
5 Check filter housing/rack for dirt bypass – clean rack and seal any gaps
6 Record filter replacement date and installer name in maintenance log
EVAPORATOR COIL INSPECTION & CLEANING
7 Remove evaporator section access panel – inspect coil face for dirt and microbial growth
8 Check all-aluminum evaporator coil for surface corrosion or damaged fins
9 Apply approved no-rinse evaporator coil cleaner – allow to drain into condensate pan
10 Straighten bent fins with fin comb if required (3–4 rows deep, 14 FPI)
11 Verify drainage from evaporator coil to condensate pan is clear and unobstructed
CONDENSER COIL INSPECTION & CLEANING
12 Inspect condenser coil fins for dirt, leaves, insects, and debris accumulation
13 Clean condenser coil with low-pressure water or approved coil cleaner – rinse inside-out
14 Check louvered coil protection panels – secure and undamaged
15 Straighten damaged fins if required (1–2 rows deep, 27 FPI)
16 Allow coil to dry fully before returning unit to service
CONDENSATE SYSTEM SERVICE
17 Flush condensate drain pan with water and mild disinfectant – remove algae/slime
18 Flush condensate drain line with water – confirm free flow at outlet
19 Inspect and clean condensate drain trap – ensure trap water seal is maintained
20 Check 3/4" NPT condensate drain connection – tighten if any leakage found
REFRIGERANT SYSTEM CHECK
21 Check suction pressure (R-410A): _______ psig (Typical at 35°C ambient: 115–130 psig)
22 Check discharge pressure (R-410A): _______ psig (Typical at 35°C ambient: 380–440 psig)
23 Suction line – cold to touch, sweating normally (no frost = adequate charge)
24 Electronic refrigerant leak detection – all joints, valves, and connections
25 No oil staining near refrigerant connections (oil = refrigerant leak indicator)
ELECTRICAL SYSTEM CHECK
26 Check and tighten all accessible electrical terminal connections (control and power)
27 Measure supply voltage: _______ V (Normal: 220–240V for PU-02 to PU-09 | 400–420V for PU-01)
28 Measure compressor running amps: _______ A (Check against RLA on unit nameplate)
29 Measure condenser fan motor running amps: _______ A
30 Measure indoor ECM blower motor running amps: _______ A
31 Visually inspect run capacitor – no bulging, leaking, or cracked case
32 Check contactor contacts – no pitting, burning, or excessive wear visible
MECHANICAL CHECK
33 Run compressor for 15 min – check for abnormal vibration, noise, or overheating
34 Check blower wheel through access for debris – clean if dirty
35 All access panels and latches – secure, sealed, no missing fasteners
36 Check unit mounting to roof curb – no loosening, no water ingress at base
BELT / SHEAVE ADJUSTMENT
Note: NOT APPLICABLE – Daikin DP15CH Series uses ECM variable-speed direct-drive indoor blower motors. No drive belts or sheaves are installed. Belt tension check and sheave adjustment are not required at this or any interval.
LUBRICATION
Note: NOT APPLICABLE – Condenser fan motor is totally enclosed and permanently factory-lubricated. ECM indoor blower motor uses sealed bearings requiring no lubrication. No greasing or oiling is required at 3-month or any other interval.
CONTROLS & THERMOSTAT CHECK
37 Verify thermostat/room controller set point is at design condition
38 Check control wiring connections in unit control panel – none loose or corroded
39 Confirm high-pressure switch – operational (do not override safety manually)
40 Confirm low-pressure switch – operational (do not override safety manually)
41 Test BMS/DDC digital points (start/stop, status, alarm) if connected
DOCUMENTATION
42 Record all pressure, temperature, voltage, and amperage readings in maintenance log
43 Update filter replacement record with date, filter size, and condition at removal
44 Raise corrective work orders for all deficiencies identified during this service
45 Obtain client/supervisor sign-off on completed PM checklist

# CHECKPOINT OK ✓ NOT OK ✗ Remarks
REFRIGERANT SYSTEM – COMPREHENSIVE INSPECTION

COMPRESSOR – FULL INSPECTION

9 Measure compressor surface temperature: _______ °C (Should not exceed 70°C)
10 Check compressor vibration isolation mounts – no cracking or collapse
11 Verify crankcase heater operation – heater warms compressor base (critical after shutdown)
12 Check compressor discharge and suction service valves – fully back-seated (open)
13 Listen for scroll compressor abnormalities – no slugging, liquid carry-over, or rattling
14 Check Schrader valve cores – no leakage; replace caps after pressure check
ELECTRICAL SYSTEM – FULL CHECK
15 Measure supply voltage: _______ V (PU-01: 400–420V, 3-phase | PU-02 to PU-09: 220–240V, 1-phase)

19 Insulation resistance test – condenser fan motor: _______ MΩ

21 Inspect and clean electrical control panel interior – remove dust with dry compressed air
22 Tighten all terminal blocks, contactors, relays, and breaker terminals
23 Check all contactors – inspect contact faces for pitting or burning; replace if >50% worn

HEAT PUMP / DEFROST SYSTEM CHECK
26 Check reversing valve operation – confirm unit switches between cooling and heating modes

30 Test defrost termination – verify cycle ends at approx. 24°C (75°F) or 10-min override

Note: Defrost and reversing valve checks apply where heat pump function is configured. Confirm each unit designation: PU-01 (DCC 102) and PU-02 to PU-09 (DP15CH Series). Verify heat pump capability on unit nameplate before performing reversing valve or defrost tests.
COIL & AIRSIDE – DEEP CLEANING
32 Deep clean evaporator coil with foaming coil cleaner – contact time per product spec, flush with water
33 Deep clean condenser coil – back-flush with water; inspect for corrosion after cleaning

MECHANICAL – FULL INSPECTION

43 Check compressor sound blanket – fully covering compressor and secured in place

45 Check unit base frame structural integrity – no corrosion, cracks, or deformation
BELT / SHEAVE CHECK
Note: NOT APPLICABLE – Daikin DP15CH Series RTUs use ECM variable-speed direct-drive motors for indoor airflow. No drive belts or sheaves are fitted on any of these units (PU-01 to PU-09). Belt tension, alignment, and sheave adjustment are not required at any maintenance interval.
LUBRICATION
Note: NOT APPLICABLE – Condenser fan motor is totally enclosed with permanently sealed bearings (Daikin specification). ECM indoor blower motor uses sealed precision bearings rated for unit service life with no re-lubrication required. No grease fittings, oil ports, or external lubrication points exist on these units.

53 Check all access panel hinges, latches, and seals – replace worn seals
